comparison.objective: Compress twelve cell springs with a pressure plate and capture preload using a cross-key; candidate extracts one terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Distributed multi-contact alignment, sustained compression and transverse key insertion versus localized tab release and same-direction tool-wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: All twelve contacts within compression/alignment limits, key seated and stable after release; candidate requires one terminal removed with connector intact. Candidate thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Preload capture and many-body alignment test different manipulation abilities.
